entries.text: CLYST: lt-m gy, sft, stc, slty, sl calc, spec /dk gy sh frags.
TR OST, FORAMS.
SND: ls, qtzs, clr, pred vf-f, occ m-vc, ang, pr sph.
TR SHELL FRAGS.
TR MICA
CLYST: lt-m gy, sft, stc, slty, sl calc, /v s sh frags, shell frags.
TR SD: clr, vf-vc, occ pk-rd stn, ang, pr sph.
TR SHELL FRAGS.
CLYST: m-lt gy, sft, stc, slty, sl calc.
TR META RK: vcol, v hd, qtzc, mica.
TR SLT: dk brn, mod hd, mic-mica.
TR SD: lse, clr, vf, sbang-rd.
TR: LS : crm.wh, sft-mod hd, pkst.
CLYST: dk gn.gy.- brn.gy, sft-mod hd, non calc.
TR:LS : crm-wh.mod.hd, pkst.

notes: CLYST entry at top starts above the green line, skipped

entries.text: TR LS: lt gy-brn, spec, mod hd, ang brk, mly.
CLYST: m gy-gy brn, fm-mod hd, sl calc, blky brk, slty, non-swlg.
TR SD: clr, f-m, sbrd, sbsph, ls.

notes: mud box 'MW INCREASED TO 9.4 PPG' ignored

entries.text: SND: ls, cl, qtzs, pred vf-f, rr m-c, ang, pr sph.
CLYST: lt-m gy, sft, stc, slty, sl calc, spec / dk gy sh frags.
CLYST: lt-m gy, occ v lt gy, mod hd, occ sft, occ calc, non-swlg
TR LS: orng/bf, hd, mly.
TR GLAUC: blk-dk gn, nod, rd, hd, f.
CLYST: lt-m gy, occ gy/bn, pred mod hd, occ sft, blky brk, pred non calc.
CLYST: m gy-gn/gy-bn, occ lt bn.
TR SHELL FRAGS.
CLYST: bcm less calc.

notes: CLYST entry at ~920 starts at/below lower green line, skipped

entries.text: CLYST: med.gy.pred., gy.gn.occ lt. brn. gy. hd.fiss. blky.
TR: GLAUC. DOL. LS.
CLYST: m gy.gn/gy.occ lt brn/gy. mod hd.arg.sb fis.blky brk.pyr. non calc.
TR: LS: orng.wh.bf.sft.crmbly. DOL: crmy wh.spec.blk.sft.crmbly. pkst.

notes: mud data and WIPER TRIP boxes ignored; CLYST at ~1640 starts at lower green line, logged in next tile

entries.text: CLYST: dk.gn.gy.mod.hd.blky brk. non calc.
CLYST: gn.gy.and brn.gy. sft-mod. hd. blky brk. non calc.
TUFF: gn.gy.. v.dk.gy.brn.spec.wh.& blk. mod.hd.
CLYST: gy.gn.. sft-mod.hd. blky. brk. pyr.. micros.sb.fis.occ red brn.
TUFF: v.dk.brn/gy.hd.spec. blky brk.

notes: mud data box ignored; TR: GLAUC at bottom is below lower line

entries.text: CLYST: m-dk gy, occ gy-gn, mod hd, arg, blky brk, non-calc, glauc, dism glauc, pyr.
TR LS: pa orng-crm, sft, cmbly brk.
CLYST: gy gn - gy brn, sft - mod hd, blky brk.
TR: GLAUC: blk nod, rd, hd. DOL: v.pa. brn/off wh, pkst, fri, hd.
CLYST: sft - mod hd, gygn - gy. brn. blky brk, pyr, glauc, non calc.
CLYST: dk gn gy - brn gy, pred sft.

notes: mud data and PIPE STUCK boxes ignored

entries.text: TR SD: ls, clr, f-m grn, ang, sb sph, v hd
TR LS: wh, sft, mly
CLYST: gn/gy, occ red/brn, mod hd, blky brk, non calc
CLYST: gn/gy-red/brn, sft-mod hd, pyr, calc
TR GLAUC: blk, nod, rd, hd
CLYST: pa gn-gy, occ blk, mod hd-sft, arg, blky brk, sl fiss, calc, PYR. GLAUC.

notes: WIPER TRIP, WIRELINE LOGS and mud boxes ignored; TR LS at ~1881 is below lower line

entries.text: SD: ls, clr, pred vf-f, rr m-c, ang-sbang, mod-w srt, sbelg-sbsph.
CLYST: lt-m gy, occ lt brn+olv gn, sft, stc, slty, sl calc, spec/dk gy sh frags.
CLYST: m gy-bf/gy, v sft, slty, occ calc
TR SHELL FRAGS

GLAUC: v dk gn, nod, rd, hd, occ lt gn.

notes: several boxes (pilot hole, mud data, wireline logs, leak off test) ignored

notes: WIPER TRIP and mud boxes ignored; SD under TR: group treated as trace
